title: Full Creative Control Within Brief
tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcript includes the unrelated spoken phrase “음악이야.”, which adds an incongruous element to the watering scene.

judge.summary: A polished animated robot visibly waters a sunflower’s soil, with only an unrelated spoken phrase detracting from the result.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
must_haves.why: One output video is shown with a reported duration of 6.6 seconds.

must_haves.item: A tiny robot is visibly present.
must_haves.why: A small white-and-blue robot stands beside sunflowers taller than itself.

must_haves.item: A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
must_haves.why: Several clearly recognizable yellow sunflowers are visible throughout.

must_haves.item: The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.
must_haves.why: The robot tilts its green watering can, sending visible streams onto the soil near the main sunflower’s base, with pooling visible in the last frame.
